answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock stake subject to non-refundable burning: verification fees follow a superlinear cost curve $C(k) \propto k^2$ for $k$ identities. An attacker creating counterfeit nodes faces an exponential surge in burned capital, dropping their ROI to its nadir. Like a saffron dye infusing deep into water, this irreversible economic river guarantees that scaling redundant identities becomes mathematically ruinous.
